  Special Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, January 24, 2023  5:00 PM  City Hall

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order in person in the City Hall Conference room and via teleconference at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, January 24,
2023. The agenda for the Special Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth
below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, January 19, 2023.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under City Council Meeting agendas at rhe.city and during regular
  business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Public Comment is welcome in-person on any item during
  City Council consideration of the item. Public correspondence may also be emailed to the City Clerk at
  laurenp@rollinghillsestates.gov. Emails received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be
  forwarded to the City Council for their consideration and included as part of the record. Members of the
  public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos” page of
  the City’s website(www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an
  “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s
  SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These
  comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the record.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JANUARY 24, 2023

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR HUFF at 5:00 PM.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INTERVIEWS OF APPLICANTS FOR PLANNING COMMISSION, ENVIRONMENTAL
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE and TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE VACANCIES

The City Council conducted interviews for following applicants for the three vacancies on
the Planning Commission, one vacancy on the Environmental Advisory Committee, and two
vacancies on the Traffic & Safety Committee:

  5:00 – Jeff Romanelli
  5:10 – Gary Mancuso
  5:20 – Brier Boyd
  5:30 – Joan Friedman
  5:40 – Will Nicklas
  5:50 – Navi Uppal
  6:00 – Simone Schmidt
  6:10 – Rena Nash
  6:20 – Susan Robinson

5.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:58 pm MAYOR HUFF adjourned the Special City Council meeting to the regular City
Council meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Britt Huff
City Clerk  Mayor
